text:
olivia-sales: Kicking off NovusBank POC. They want streaming (gRPC streaming preferred, SSE fallback), structured function/tool-calls, schema versioning, on-prem connector (VPC), SAML SSO, and offline KMS/HSM. Also asked for a quick pricing estimate for ~300 qps baseline, spikes to 1.5k qps. Can eng/presales help with a checklist + known blockers? :wave:

dan-eng: Noted. Which client SDKs? They plan to run a Java edge adapter and Ruby backend.

olivia-sales: Yes — Java at the edge for low-latency handshake, Ruby on server. Edge must support ephemeral creds and proxy-friendly transports.

mike-ml: Streaming recommendation: gRPC streams where possible for bidirectional low-latency; SSE as fallback for strict HTTP proxies. For function/tool calls we stream partial call frames so the UI can show progressive results. Example streamed line we send over SSE/Gs: {"frame":"tool.part","id":"t-42","payload":"{"name":"get_tx","partial":"{\"tx_id\":\"...\"}"}"} (we usually escape inside the string).

 dan-eng: Java ephemeral token header snippet: 
import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
HttpRequest.newBuilder()
  .uri(new URI("https://inference.redwood.example/v1/stream"))
  .header("Authorization", "Bearer " + token)
  .header("X-Req-Id", reqId)
  ...
Rotate tokens every 5 minutes for edge agents.

claire-se: Compliance notes: we can provide SOC2 and ISO27001 summaries, privacy addendum, and offline KMS integration for Private/on-prem customers (HSM connector available). I'll share the security contact and pen-test summary.

infra-bot: If sustained >500 qps consider Dedicated capacity. Hosted can absorb bursts but unit cost is higher. See /pricing/dedicated-estimator. GPU lead time ~3-4 weeks for Dedicated.

olivia-sales: Blockers checklist for POC?

dan-eng: Key blockers: 1) network path — allowlist IPs or VPC peering/VPN, 2) exchange SAML metadata + testing IdP, 3) test KMS/HSM access or test creds, 4) client acceptance prompt set and schema contract, 5) performance SLAs and expected model sizes. If allowlist not possible, we can use site-to-site VPN or deploy a short-lived agent.

mike-ml: Structured-output guidance: include a top-level schema_version and a structured.results array so our evals and telemetry can validate tool-call shapes. Example payload we prefer: {"schema_version":"1.1","response":"...","structured":{"tool_calls":[{"name":"get_tx","status":"ok","result":{...}}],"assertions":[{"id":"amt-check","ok":true}]}}

olivia-sales: Pricing ballpark for email? They want a quick number to decide whether to pursue Dedicated.

dan-eng: Rough: hosted pay-as-you-go often 2-3x per-token vs committed Dedicated. For 300 qps steady with spikes to 1.5k, a small Dedicated pool + hosted burst is typical. Exact ranges depend on model family (Llama-2 style vs larger recent checkpoints) and quantization. Provide this high-level and say we'll return a specific estimator after confirming model choice.

claire-se: I'll DM the security contact and attach SOC2/ISO summaries and pen-test note.

dan-eng: I'll prep allowlist ranges, Java snippet, and a short runbook for Java edge adapter + gRPC/SSE fallback. Aim to share by EOD tomorrow.

mike-ml: I'll prepare a tiny eval set that asserts schema_version and tool_call shapes (fails fast if malformed) and share structured-output examples.

olivia-sales: Thanks all. I'll consolidate into a one-pager for the customer and request their SAML metadata and network owner contact. Target POC start in ~2 weeks if SAML and network cleared. :calendar: :thumbsup:

[thread end]
